evidence_boundaries: Real RF/OSA/MOPA experiments plus numeric waveforms; not plasma SBS or laser-plasma accelerator experiment.
57 percent is same seventh-order target before/after real waveform feedback; measured linewidth changes 6.99 to 7.25 GHz.
Across first to seventh envelope order thresholds rise 2955 to 3562 W, about 20.54 percent; actual RMS width changes 6.45 to 7.25 GHz, not matched linewidth.
RMS linewidth mathematical definition, spectral integration window and baseline subtraction absent; no FWHM conversion made.
Figure 8 uses measured voltage and Vpi model to derive spectra; Figure 10 is independently OSA measured.
Backward mW is relative isolator-port fraction, not absolute backward light; onset of PD self-pulsing and interlock defines threshold.
M2 measured at 3.5 kW; no long-duration stability, coherent combining or wall-plug efficiency acceptance.
Multi-step code, δ, waveform/calibration data, amplifier effective fiber length and repeated-threshold uncertainties unavailable.
